title: Yielding Japanese Beef Gyudon
description: A buttery, molten breakfast bowl that fuses tandoor-grilled beef with a citrusy onion sauce, served over cauliflower rice for a whole30-friendly brunch.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 200C and place beef slices on the grill rack.
Grill the beef for 2 minutes per side until seared, then remove from the tandoor.
Heat coconut oil and sesame oil in the cataplana over medium heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in rice wine vinegar, sea salt, and black pepper, cook for 1 minute.
Return the grilled beef to the cataplana and toss with onions and sauce, cooking for 2 minutes to heat through.
Add cauliflower rice to the pan, stir to combine and warm for 3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to serving plates and garnish with sliced green onions.
